en.heroTitle: PROFESSIONAL GLASS & MIRROR WORKS IN KUWAIT
en.heroText:
Professional glass, mirrors, tempered glass,
laminated glass and double glazing for homes,
offices, shops and commercial projects in Kuwait.
en.aboutHeading: Professional Glass and Mirror work in Kuwait
en.aboutText:
Design Glass & Mirror provides professional
glass, mirror, tempered glass, laminated glass,
double glass, shower glass, glass partitions,
glass railings, staircase glass, office glass
and aluminum works in Kuwait.
en.service1Text:
Tempered and toughened glass for doors,
partitions, stairs, shops and offices.
en.service2Text:
Laminated safety glass for projects
requiring additional protection.
en.service3Text:
Double glass and double glazing solutions
for homes, offices and buildings.
en.service4Text:
Modern shower glass doors and bathroom
glass solutions in Kuwait.
en.service5Text:
Glass partitions and railings for
offices, homes, stairs and balconies.
en.service6Text:
Custom mirrors, LED mirrors and
aluminum works.
en.galleryDescription:
Tempered glass, laminated glass, double glass,
mirrors, shower glass, partitions, railings,
stairs, doors and interior projects in Kuwait.
en.why4Text: We work closely with our customers.
en.contactText:
Contact us for tempered glass,
toughened glass, laminated glass,
double glass, shower glass,
partitions, railings, staircase glass,
mirrors, office glass and aluminum works.
